summary: Australia (AU) localization of Business Central 29. It covers GST posting and settlement, Business Activity Statements (BAS), withholding tax (WHT), ABN and adjustment notes, tax invoices, EFT payments, post-dated checks, address validation and cost-plus pricing. Use it to answer how AU tax, banking and reporting differ from W1.
overview:
The Australian layer adds 171 objects of its own and changes about 120 W1 objects, with 468 fields, 22 events and 218 procedures added. The main capabilities are GST handling (full GST, GST on prepayments, ACY amount fields, settlement exchange rates), BAS setup, calculation and export, and withholding tax with its own posting groups, entries, certificates and settlement.

The code supports these through new fields on posting and master tables. These include ABN, ABN Division Part No., WHT Business and Product Posting Group, Adjustment and BAS Adjustment fields, tax document fields and EFT fields. Posting codeunits such as Gen. Jnl.-Post Line, Sales-Post, Purch.-Post and the prepayment codeunits get GST and WHT procedures. Own codeunits include ABN Management, BAS Management, BAS Export, WHTManagement, TaxInvoiceManagement, EFT Management and PostDatedCheckMgt.

Learn documents the local functionality under "Australia local functionality", with pages on Australian Tax, withholding tax, ABNs and adjustment notes, GST posting, EFT, e-invoicing with Peppol PINT A-NZ, Payment Times Reporting, addresses and AU-specific reports.
key_points: GST: Enable GST (Australia) in General Ledger Setup, full GST and GST on prepayments, ACY amount fields on lines, GST sales and purchase entry pages, and a Calculate GST Settlement report.
BAS: BAS Setup, calculation sheet, business units for group lodging, BAS Export codeunit, and BAS fields on VAT Report Header and G/L Entry.
Withholding tax: WHT Business and Product Posting Groups, WHT Posting Setup, revenue types, WHT Entry, certificates, minimum invoice amounts, and Calc. and Post WHT Settlement.
ABN and adjustment notes: ABN and ABN Division Part No. on company, customer, vendor and contact; Adjustment, BAS Adjustment and Adjustment Applies-to fields, with an Adjustment Mandatory setting.
Tax invoices: posted sales and purchase tax invoice and credit memo pages, separate number series, and tax invoice and credit memo reports.
Banking: EFT register, Transfer EFT Register and Create EFT File, post-dated checks, bank reconciliation, deposit slip and cash flow compare reports.
Address handling: counties, AMAS address validation and DPID bar codes; also cost-plus pricing fields on price lines and Peppol PINT A-NZ e-invoicing documented on Learn.

areas.what: Adds GST, BAS and WHT to general ledger posting. New objects include ABN Management, BAS Management, BAS Export logic, WHTManagement, TaxInvoiceManagement and the BAS pages. W1 tables such as Gen. Journal Line, VAT Entry, G/L Entry and General Ledger Setup gain BAS, adjustment, settlement and WHT fields, and Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gains GST and WHT procedures and events.
areas.why: Learn describes GST posting for BAS reporting to the ATO, and WHT withheld from vendors without an ABN.

areas.what: Purchase documents and vendors get ABN, WHT group, adjustment and ACY amount fields. Purch.-Post, prepayment and invoice posting codeunits add WHT and full GST procedures. Purchases & Payables Setup holds GST, WHT certificate, tax invoice number series and post-dated check settings.
areas.why: Learn covers vendor ABN setup and WHT for vendors without an ABN.

areas.what: Sales documents and customers get ABN, sales tax type, WHT, adjustment, tax document and ACY fields. Sales-Post and prepayment codeunits add GST and WHT procedures. Sales & Receivables Setup adds tax invoice numbering and post-dated check options. AU/NZ Statement is a new report.

Adds ABN and related registration fields to Company Information, address validation (AMAS) and county tables, and address formatting for tax documents and bar codes. DateFilter-Calc gets period verification procedures.
areas.why: Learn explains DPID bar coding and AMAS validation to improve postal efficiency, and ABN entry on company cards.

areas.what: Adds EFT payments (bank fields, EFT Register, Transfer EFT Register and Create EFT File), post-dated check fields on ledger entries, and WHT handling in bank reconciliation posting. Includes bank reconciliation, deposit slip, cash flow compare and backdated aged reports.
areas.why: Learn documents EFT payment of vendors and the AU bank reports.

areas.what: Adds a WHT Product Posting Group to items, item templates and item charges, a vendor exchange rate (ACY) on item journal lines, and cost-plus price updates in ItemCostManagement. Adds Stock Card and Stock Movement reports.
areas.why: Learn describes determining sales price by cost plus percentage.

areas.what: Holds the BAS Export codeunit, the G/L-BAS permission set and a source code table extension.
Provides bar code management with a codeunit and two reports for checking and batch bar code generation.
areas.why: Learn mentions DPID bar code printing for addresses.

areas.what: Price List Line and Price Worksheet Line gain Published Price, Cost, Cost-plus % and Discount Amount fields, with procedures that update the unit price from cost-plus percentage.
areas.why: Learn documents sales price determination by cost plus percentage.

areas.what: The LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets are changed for the AU objects.
Adds service document management for APAC and a service manager role center page extension.
Contact gains ABN, Registered, ABN Division Part No. and IRD No. fields.
areas.why: Learn lists contacts among the cards where an ABN is entered.

areas.what: Adds an AU expense event subscriber codeunit.
Fixed Asset gains a WHT Product Posting Group field.
The data migration facade helper gets a procedure to create counties when needed.
Incoming purchase document pre-mapping can find a vendor by ABN, with a new event after setting header data.
Resource gains a WHT Product Posting Group field.

issues: Overview says Sales-Post gets GST and WHT procedures; its added procedures are WHT-related, and the sales-side GST procedures are in Sales Post Invoice and Sales-Post Prepayments. Acceptable as a group-level statement.

The 171 own objects include shared Asia-Pacific objects that look meant for other countries, such as WHT PND reports, Certificate of Creditable tax and Quarterly VAT Return. The narrative rightly does not present them as Australian features, but the count includes them.
Small omissions: the Recurring Amount - Distribute codeunit (distribution amounts, documented on Learn) and the Expense Event Subscriber AU codeunit are not mentioned.
